passScope: Pure helper imports no DB, environment, filesystem, network, Payload or business service. It does not mutate supplied input.
CLI accepts only --input/--as-of/--output or standalone --help, reads explicit JSON, and writes only a new report with wx/0600; it has no execution mode.

JSON record, top-level and reference fields are restricted; private values are rejected and not echoed in errors/output. Dates are normalized or classified for manual review rather than copied blindly.
Recent updatedAt does not hide records created at least one year ago or establish renewal. Actual join drafts, invalid/missing dates and related-policy scope remain manual-review matters.
All input records remain in output. No canDelete/deleteEligible field exists. readOnly=true, automaticDeletion=false and expiryConfirmed=false apply to the whole report.

Current and revoked canonical memberships and joined community relations are classified separately from application material. Source application, establishment, historical team version and community office reference warnings preserve dependency review.
referencesComplete is an operator assertion only; it neither checks DB completeness nor grants row deletion permission.

Confirmed one-year registration policy, long-term membership policy and Ye Jiaxin responsibility match user instructions. Document explicitly states automatic enforcement is unimplemented and deployed services/copies remain unverified.

syntheticValidation.method: Pinned TypeScript transpiled in Node VM; helper has no injected external API. CLI uses in-memory synthetic fs and explicit synthetic argv with no process.env. Only the final review evidence is written to /tmp.
